summary: Walks a singly linked list owned by the receiver. For each node, reads the flag byte at obj+0x8 and the next-pointer at obj+0x4; when the flag is nonzero and the embedded data pointer at obj+0x0 is non-null, calls EmptyStub_0170 and frees the embedded data. Every node is then freed with FreeWrapper_7bcf. Finally the list head and the three following dwords (0x0/0x4/0x8/0xC) are zeroed and 0 is returned.

operations.description: Load the list head *this into the walk cursor v2.
while (v2 != 0): iterate over every node until the next-pointer chain terminates.
Capture the current node v3, read its flag byte at obj+0x8, and advance the cursor to the next node via the pointer at obj+0x4.
If the node's flag byte at obj+0x8 is nonzero, release the embedded data.
If the embedded data pointer at obj+0x0 is non-null, run the stub and free it.
EmptyStub_0170 invoked before freeing the embedded data.
FreeWrapper_7bcf on the embedded data pointer read from obj+0x0.
FreeWrapper_7bcf on the node itself v3.
Reset the list head this+0x0 to 0.
